outlook.statement: Management is making efforts for the speedy recovery of business operations.

The Company evaluates the performance of its investments on a periodic basis. Also, the investments have been placed for a long term objective and any deterioration for a temporary period is not taken into account while evaluating the performance of its investments. Majority of the investments are placed for strategic management purposes.

risks: At present, the Company has not identified any element of risk which may threaten the existence of the Company.
Risks are categorised into Strategic, Financial, Operational, Compliance & Reputational.
Focus was on reviewing effectiveness of actions taken to mitigate business, cyber security and other operational & Compliance risks.
Credit risk arises from cash and bank balances, trade receivables and other financial assets.
Liquidity risk is defined as the risk that the Company will not be able to settle or meet its obligations on time or at a reasonable price.
Price risk arises from investments in units, equity instruments and mutual funds classified as fair value through OCI or fair value through profit or loss.
